title: Identification and functional characterization of a novel ovarian-specific Kelch domain-containing gene involved in the ecdysteroid signaling pathway of Penaeus monodon.
authors: Kluebsoongnoen, Jakkapong; Tanramluk, Duangrudee; Jozghorbani, Maryam; Phetcharaburanin, Jutarop; Sarnowski, Tomasz J; Udomkit, Apinunt
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Part A, Molecular & integrative physiology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究虾类卵巢特异Kelch蛋白PmKel在蜕皮激素信号通路中对卵黄蛋白原表达的调控，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作与对接，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: In crustaceans, vitellogenin (Vg) synthesis is regulated by complex hormonal and molecular networks. This study investigates the role of the ecdysone receptor (PmEcR) in regulating Vg expression and identifies downstream effectors in Penaeus monodon. Silencing of PmEcR using RNA interference resulted in a two-fold increase in Vg expression and a significant rise in the gonadosomatic index (GSI), suggesting PmEcR acts as a suppressor of vitellogenesis. Through a suppression subtractive hybridization (SSH) technique, an uncharacterized LOC 113805388 gene, was identified as being downregulated upon PmEcR silencing. Functional and structural characterization revealed this transcript as an ovarian-specific protein with a beta-propeller structure (Kelch-like domain-containing protein; PmKel), suggesting that it belongs to a Kelch-like protein family generally involved in protein-protein interactions in cellular regulation. LC-MS/MS analysis of the ovarian proteome confirmed the presence of the PmKel protein, verifying its expression in the ovary. PmKel expression displayed an inverse pattern to that of Vg during ovarian development, and its knockdown was associated with increased Vg transcript levels, suggesting a possible role in the regulation of Vg gene expression. In addition, a recombinant PmKel protein was produced and used as a bait to identify its partners in ovarian nuclear extract by affinity purification mass spectrometry (AP-MS). The isolated set of interacting proteins highlighted functional enrichment in mRNA and protein metabolic processes involved in developmental pathways. Also, these proteins could interact with a Kelch-like domain predicted on PmKel 3D protein structure by protein network analysis and protein-protein docking. These findings suggest that PmKel is a novel ovarian specific Kelch-containing protein that plays a key role in the vitellogenesis regulatory network via the EcR pathway. Collectively, these results add to the current knowledge of shrimp reproduction and may suggest future direction for improving reproductive performance in aquaculture.
abstract_zh: 在甲壳类动物中，卵黄蛋白原（vitellogenin, Vg）的合成受复杂的激素和分子网络调控。本研究探讨了蜕皮激素受体（PmEcR）在调控Vg表达中的作用，并鉴定了斑节对虾（Penaeus monodon）中的下游效应因子。通过RNA干扰沉默PmEcR导致Vg表达增加两倍，并显著提高性腺指数（gonadosomatic index, GSI），表明PmEcR作为卵黄发生的抑制因子发挥作用。利用抑制性消减杂交（suppression subtractive hybridization, SSH）技术，鉴定出一个未表征的LOC 113805388基因，在PmEcR沉默后其表达下调。功能和结构表征揭示该转录本为一种卵巢特异性蛋白，具有β-螺旋桨结构（含Kelch样结构域蛋白；PmKel），提示其属于Kelch样蛋白家族，该家族通常参与细胞调控中的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。卵巢蛋白质组的LC-MS/MS分析确认了PmKel蛋白的存在，验证了其在卵巢中的表达。PmKel表达在卵巢发育过程中与Vg呈相反模式，其敲低与Vg转录水平升高相关，提示其可能在Vg基因表达调控中发挥作用。此外，制备了重组PmKel蛋白，并用作诱饵，通过亲和纯化质谱（affinity purification mass spectrometry, AP-MS）鉴定其在卵巢核提取物中的相互作用伙伴。分离出的相互作用蛋白集突出富集于参与发育途径的mRNA和蛋白质代谢过程。此外，通过蛋白质网络分析和蛋白质-蛋白质对接，这些蛋白可能与PmKel三维蛋白结构上预测的Kelch样结构域相互作用。这些发现表明，PmKel是一种新型卵巢特异性含Kelch蛋白，通过EcR途径在卵黄发生调控网络中发挥关键作用。综合来看，这些结果增进了对虾繁殖的现有认识，并可能为水产养殖中改善繁殖性能提供未来方向。
